moqui.llm.LlmSkill.body: # Order and invoice reports Read only. No sim. No confirm. GL income statement and balance sheet: `review-accounting-reports`. Inventory on hand: `inventory-asset-reports`. # Sales Summary (ElasticSearch) Screen `/apps/marble/Accounting/Reports/SalesSummary`. Link `/qapps/marble/Accounting/Reports/SalesSummary`. For a dashboard, summary, trend, or how-are-sales question, `run_service` the four services below. Do not GET the screen to scrape charts. Stat cards and charts are templates over those results. If the tool message says ElasticSearch is not available or no ElasticClient, say that and use the relational reports below. Summary Options, pass the same values into the services. `interval`: `d` day, `w` week, `M` month, `q` quarter, `y` year. Screen defaults `interval=w` and `intervalCount=13`. Services default `interval=M`, so a call that should match the screen must pass `w`. `thruDate` defaults to today. `maPeriods` default `0` (moving-average lookback; `0` disables it). Filters: `vendorPartyIds` (role `OrgInternal`), `productStoreIds`, `customerClassificationIds` (`PcltCustomer`), `customerPartyIds`, `productIds` (finished inventory `AsClsInventoryFin`). Empty vendor means every vendor in the index. Set `vendorPartyIds` to `activeOrgId` when the user means this company. The screen passes `vendorPartyIds` as invoice `fromPartyIds` and `customerPartyIds` as `toPartyIds`. Services are `mantle.sales.SalesReportServices`, cluster `default`, index name default `mantle_sales` (the real index is the DataDocument index). `get#SalesOrderSummary` reads `MantleSalesOrderItem` on `placedDate`. Status filter on both `partStatusId` and `statusId`: `OrderPlaced` `OrderProcessing` `OrderApproved` `OrderSent` `OrderCompleted` `OrderHold`. Date histogram, newest bucket first, then the list is reversed. Aggregations: cardinality of `orderId`; sum of `itemSaleTotal`; `ItemProduct` (`itemTypeEnumId=ItemProduct`) sums `itemSaleTotal`, `issuances.issuedSaleTotal`, `issuances.issuedCostTotal`, `orderQuantity`; discount filter sums `itemSaleTotal` for `ItemDiscount` `ItemPromptDiscount` `ItemCouponCredit` `ItemPromoDiscount` `ItemFreeFills` `ItemSlottingFees` `ItemAdjAdvertising` `ItemAdjJointAdv`; new customers are `isNewCustomer=Y` and a cardinality of `orderId`. `netSales` is product sales plus the discount total (discount item amounts are negative). `discountPercent` is `-discountTotal/productSaleTotal`. `costPercent` is issued cost over issued sales. `newCustomerPercent` is new-customer orders over order count. `get#SalesInvoiceSummary` reads `MantleSalesInvoice` and `MantleSalesInvoiceItem` on `invoiceDate`. Statuses: `InvoiceFinalized` `InvoiceSent` `InvoiceAcked` `InvoicePmtRecvd` (not in process). Header sums: `invoiceTotal`, `appliedPaymentsTotal` (paid), `prePaymentsTotal`. Item side: cardinality of `invoiceId`, `ItemProduct` sums of `itemSaleTotal`, issued sale, issued cost, and `quantity`, plus the same discount types. `paidPercent` is payments applied over `invoiceTotal`. `prePaidPercent` is prepayments over `invoiceTotal`. `get#SalesTopProduct` is one period, `poffset=-1` (the previous period, not the current one). Screen passes `topLimit=15` (service default `10`). Terms on `productId`. Fields: `totalSales`, `totalQuantity`, `productIssuedTotal`, `productCostTotal`, `costPercent`. Margin percent is `1 - costPercent`. `get#InvoicesByCustomerClass` is that same previous period. Terms on `customerClassId`. Header totals from `MantleSalesInvoice`, item totals from `MantleSalesInvoiceItem`. Out maps `ordersThis` `ordersLast` `ordersPrior` `ordersAverage` and the invoice twins. This is the current open period and is excluded from Prior Total and Prior Average. Last is the previous complete period. Prior is the one before that. Series: orders, new customers, new customer percent, invoices; product ordered, order discounts, discount percent; product invoiced, invoice discounts, product cost; order discount percent, invoice discount percent, invoice cost percent. Order Issued and Invoiced `/OrderIssuedInvoiced` form `OrderIssuedInvoiced`, entity `mantle.order.OrderItemShipBillSummary`. Default statuses `OrderApproved,OrderCompleted,OrderHold`. moqui.llm.LlmSkill.body: # Sales return Before this write: if the prompt lists a QuickSearch or QuickLookup actions path, GET it and create only when nothing matches. Vendor on a customer return is the company: `vendorPartyId`=activeOrgId. Do not post card numbers. Find GET `/apps/marble/Return/FindReturn/actions/ReturnHeaderList` `returnType`=Customer. **Create Customer Return** POST `createReturn` (form CreateReturn): `customerPartyId`, `vendorPartyId`=activeOrgId, `facilityId`. Or OrderDetail **Create Return** POST `createReturnFromOrder` `orderId`, `orderPartSeqId`. EditReturn: **Set Requested** POST `requestReturn` (`ReturnCreated` → `ReturnRequested`). **Approve** POST `approveReturn` (`ReturnApproved`). **Cancel** POST `cancelReturn`. Add lines `/apps/marble/Return/AddOrderItems` form AddOrderItemToReturn POST `addOrderItemToReturn`: `returnId`, `orderId`, `orderItemSeqId`, `returnQuantity` or `responseAmount`, `returnReasonEnumId`, `returnResponseEnumId`, `responseImmediate` (`N` on received, `Y` on approved). Response enum: `RrspCredit` Credit, `RrspRefund` Refund, `RrspReplace` Replace, `RrspManual` Manual. Set it with EditReturnItems form ReturnItemList POST `updateReturnItem`. **Create Return Shipment** POST `createReturnShipment` `returnId`. Customer return shipment is `ShpTpSalesReturn` (incoming). Find `/apps/marble/Shipment/FindShipment` `shipmentTypeEnumId`=`ShpTpSalesReturn`. Receive that shipment with `receive-incoming-shipment` (`receiveEntireShipment` or ReceiveItem `receive`), not `receive-inventory-direct`. **Process Item Responses** POST `processReturnItemResponses`. Credit becomes a credit memo; Refund becomes payment type `PtRefund`. **Receive without Shipment** POST `receiveReturnWithoutShipment` only if the user wants no shipment. Find credit memos `/apps/marble/Accounting/Invoice/FindInvoice` `invoiceType`=Payable `invoiceTypeEnumId`=`InvoiceCreditMemo`. Return invoices: `invoiceType`=Payable `invoiceTypeEnumId`=`InvoiceReturn`. Manual credit on an unpaid invoice: EditInvoice **New Credit Memo** POST `createCreditMemo` `originalInvoiceId`, `amount`, `description`, `itemTypeEnumId`, `invoiceDate`. Or FindInvoice **Customer Credit Memo** POST `createInvoice` with `invoiceTypeEnumId`=`InvoiceCreditMemo` (From customer, To activeOrgId). Refund already taken on a Delivered payment: EditPayment **Create Refund** POST `createRefundPayment` `paymentId`, `amount`, `statusId` (default `PmntPromised`). Find `/apps/marble/Accounting/Payment/FindPayment` `paymentType`=Outgoing `paymentTypeEnumId`=`PtRefund`. # Purchase return Same screens. **Create Supplier Return** POST `createReturn` (form CreateSupplierReturn): `vendorPartyId`=supplier, `customerPartyId`=activeOrgId, `facilityId`. Find `returnType`=Supplier. Shipment is `ShpTpPurchaseReturn` (outgoing, not an incoming receive). Do not POST `receiveEntireShipment` on it. Pack and ship with `packShipment` / `shipShipment` only if those outgoing buttons are on the shipment. Return invoice find: `invoiceType`=Receivable `invoiceTypeEnumId`=`InvoiceReturn`. Refund find: `paymentType`=Incoming `paymentTypeEnumId`=`PtRefund`. Link `/qapps/marble/Return/EditReturn?returnId=`. ## Widgets Form `/apps/marble/Return/FindReturn` `CreateReturn` POST `createReturn`. - customerPartyId drop-down "Customer" Lookup GET `/apps/marble/Return/FindReturn/searchPartyList` roleTypeId=Customer server-search min-length 2 - vendorPartyId drop-down "Vendor Org" entity mantle.party.PartyDetailAndRole key partyId text PartyNameTemplate and roleTypeId=OrgInternal partyId=<activeOrgId> disabled=N or-null disabled order organizationName,firstName,lastName - facilityId drop-down "Vendor Warehouse" Lookup GET `/apps/marble/Return/FindReturn/getWhFacilitiesByVendor` valueField facilityId depends vendorPartyId
